findings.message: apps/server/src/MatchRoom.ts keeps a module-level `outcomes: MatchOutcome[]` array. `endMatch` pushes every finished match's full MatchResults onto it and never removes any, including in the production entry (DEFAULT_MATCH_TUNING, main.ts). `recordedOutcomes()` is only read by tests and diagnostics. So a long-running production server's memory grows by one entry for every match it ever finishes. The fix is to bound it (a ring buffer, or a test-only switch like `testHooks`) or hand outcomes to a store and drop them.

A UI branch this feature added is missing from docs/match-online-coverage.md and has no test. In apps/web/src/flowHud.ts showBanner (line 647), `if (timers.hide !== undefined) window.clearTimeout(timers.hide)` re-arms the banner's 7 s hide when a new reveal arrives. The banner's auto-hide after BANNER_MS isn't asserted anywhere either. fullMatch.spec.ts only checks that the banner is hidden before the first reveal and visible after it. The host gets final-route and final-sector a few ms apart, so deleting the clearTimeout would fail no test. Add a table row and a test (for example a DOM unit test with fake timers: a second banner inside 7 s stays up for its own 7 s).
findings.requirement: A branch with no failing test gets a new test
